title: Create Blog Post entry fails when summary field is empty
expected_result: Form shows validation error for summary field and entry is not saved
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to Blog Post content type in Admin Panel
Leave summary field empty or blank
prerequisites: User has access to create Blog Post entries

title: Remove gallery component from Blog Post entry
expected_result: Component is removed and Blog Post entry is saved successfully
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to Blog Post content type
Open an entry with gallery components
Click delete/remove button on a component row
prerequisites: Blog Post entry has at least one gallery component
